about_meta_description: Ochorus is a ministry based in Victoria BC, Canada and Kampala, Uganda, publishing classic Christian books free to read online and placing printed books into hands across East Africa.
about_p1: Based in Victoria BC, Canada and Kampala, Uganda, Ochorus is a dedicated ministry with a profound mission: providing exceptional classic Christian literature and resources at no cost, to readers everywhere.
about_p2: Established in 2021, Ochorus is fueled by an unwavering commitment to spreading the gospel to every corner of the world, ensuring accessibility across many languages and devices.
about_p3: Recognizing the transformative power of literature, we identify great Christian books within the public domain, thoroughly edit them for enhanced readability, and publish them on this platform — free to read and free to keep.
about_p4: Aligned with God's desire for the salvation of all people, it is our fervent aspiration to contribute to this divine purpose, that many would read, reflect, and be transformed.
footer_mission: Free classic Christian books online — and printed books given out at conferences, churches, schools, and prisons across East Africa.
about_outreach_heading: From the Page to the Field
about_outreach_p1: Ochorus is not only a website. Across East Africa we place printed Christian books directly into people's hands — at Pastors' Conferences where church leaders gather, and in the churches, schools, and prisons we are invited to serve.
about_outreach_p2: Books printed in Uganda travel to conferences across the region, equipping pastors who carry them home to their congregations. The same titles you read here are given away freely — to a student, a prisoner, a new believer — because the word of God is not bound.
about_scripture1: So is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.
about_scripture2: I was sick, and you visited me. I was in prison, and you came to me.
about_scripture3: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom.
legal_meta_description: How Ochorus handles your privacy and the terms of using the library: read free without an account, no advertising, no cross-site tracking, and full control of your reading data.
legal_intro: Ochorus is a free ministry that publishes classic Christian books to read online and shares printed books across East Africa. This page explains, in plain terms, how we handle your information and the terms of using the site.
legal_privacy_p1: You can read the entire library without an account. If you don't sign in, your preferences and reading data — your place in a book, highlights, notes, bookmarks, and the days you read — stay in your browser on this device and are never sent to us.
legal_privacy_p2: If you create an account, we store your email address (through our sign-in provider) and sync your reading data to your account, so you can read across your phone and computer. That is the only reason we keep it.
legal_privacy_p3: We do not sell your data, show advertising, or use advertising or cross-site trackers. We don't use tracking cookies, and we don't collect your email for marketing.
legal_privacy_p4: We rely on two service providers to run the site: Supabase (sign-in and database) and Render (hosting). Your data is stored with them on our behalf.
legal_privacy_p5: You are in control: you can export or delete your reading data at any time in Settings, and deleting your account removes the data we hold for you.
legal_terms_p1: The library is free to read and free to keep. Most works are in the public domain; Ochorus's own editions and translations are offered for personal, non-commercial reading.
legal_terms_p2: Some translations are produced with the help of AI and are clearly labelled as awaiting native review. Please treat an unreviewed translation as a work in progress, not a final rendering.
legal_terms_p3: The site is provided as is, without warranties. We do our best to keep it accurate and available, but we cannot guarantee it will always be error-free or uninterrupted.
legal_terms_p4: Please use Ochorus for its purpose — reading and sharing Christian books — and do not attempt to disrupt or misuse the service.
legal_terms_p5: We may update this page from time to time; the date below shows when it last changed.
legal_ministry: Ochorus is a ministry based in Victoria, BC (Canada) and Kampala (Uganda).
